About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands—Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)—serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
ROLE OVERVIEW
Welo Global is partnering with a social media client to build high-quality training data for AI systems. We are looking for Brazilian experts with PhD level to help create challenging, expert-level questions and answers in their field. The content that will directly shape how AI understands Brazilian culture, law, history, and society.
This is a remote, flexible freelance engagement. All work is done in Brazilian Portuguese.
What you'll do
For each assignment, you will craft a challenging, expert-level question on a Brazilian topic in your field (one that AI tools cannot fully answer), write the ideal response in Brazilian Portuguese and break that response down into individually cited facts with their sources and relevance.
Important: AI tools may be used for research support only. All questions, answers, and fact breakdowns must be your own original work.
We are looking for experts in the domain listed in the job posting. As a mandatory requirement, only experts with PhD level would be considered for the role.
Project details
Language Pair: Brazilian Portuguese
Task: AI data annotation
Area of expertise (domain): History
Tools: Consumer-grade LLM with search (e.g., Gemini Pro), for prompt difficulty calibration
Estimated Volume: 60 hours over approximately 2 months, the hours are flexible, work on your own schedule
Location: Remote
Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

**Role Overview**

- Mercor is seeking senior mechanical engineering professionals to review evaluation tasks for AI systems operating in Fortune 500 enterprise product design and manufacturing contexts.
 
- The workflows are calibrated to the design complexity, safety stakes, and production scale of Fortune 500 and large industrial manufacturers.
 
- This role reviews worlds on two standards tracks: a US track (ASME) and an International track (ISO). Experts qualified in either or both tracks are encouraged to apply.
 
- Reviewers assess enterprise mechanical engineering scenarios, reference outputs, and grading rubrics that capture how senior F500 engineering leaders think.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Review mechanical engineering tasks, reference outputs, and supporting artifacts for technical accuracy, realism, and professional complexity.

**Role Overview**

Mercor is seeking experienced network engineers to build and validate technical tasks for AI systems working with enterprise, data-center, and service-provider networks.

The work focuses on executable network configurations, reproducible simulated or emulated topologies, troubleshooting, and measurable verification. Contributors create the network artifacts and reference solutions behind each task and test whether a proposed configuration produces the required behavior.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Design realistic tasks involving routing, switching, network services, segmentation, access policies, redundancy, or performance.
 
- Build reproducible network topologies and device configurations using relevant tools such as containerlab, GNS3, EVE-NG, Mininet, ns-3, FRRouting, or equivalent platforms.
 
- Configure and debug scenarios involving technologies such as BGP, OSPF, VLANs, IPv4/IPv6, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, or firewalls, within your area of expertise.
 
- Develop automated checks for reachability, route selection, policy enforcement, isolation, convergence, failover, latency, throughput, and packet loss. Use tests of live behavior alongside configuration inspection.
 
- Produce reference configurations, traffic or failure scenarios, and verification scripts; validate both successful and deliberately incorrect cases.
 
- Package topology files, configuration dependencies, scripts, packet captures, and results so another engineer can reproduce the outcome.
 
- Review AI-generated configurations and diagnose the cause of failures. Use coding agents to support automation while independently validating network behavior.

**Ideal Qualifications**

- 5+ years of professional network engineering experience, with direct ownership of enterprise, data-center, cloud, or service-provider networks.
 
- Strong hands-on routing, switching, troubleshooting, and network-policy skills.
 
- Experience building network labs, simulations, or emulations and analyzing traffic with tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, or iperf. Familiarity with every listed platform is not required.
 
- Ability to write and debug Python, shell, Ansible, or comparable automation for repeatable setup and verification.
 
- Sound judgment about protocol behavior, failure modes, measurement limitations, and differences between simulated and production networks.
 
- Clear technical communication. Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or JNCIP, and experience with network test automation, are a plus.

**Compensation**

- Writers: $70–$80/hour.
- Reviewers: $90/hour.

**Role Overview**

Mercor is seeking experienced electrical engineers to build and validate technical tasks for AI systems working with circuits, power electronics, control systems, and electrical infrastructure. The work centers on executable engineering models, simulation, debugging, and measurable verification.

Contributors create the native engineering files and reference solutions behind each task, run the relevant analyses, and define checks that distinguish a working design from a plausible but incorrect result. Tasks may follow a US standards track (NEC / NFPA 70, NESC, IEEE) or an international track (IEC), as appropriate to the engineering problem.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Build realistic tasks in one or more specialties: circuit and PCB design, power electronics, power systems, embedded systems, or industrial controls.
- Create and debug schematics, SPICE netlists, component models, control logic, and other native technical artifacts needed to reproduce a task.
- Configure operating points, initial conditions, parameter sweeps, transient or steady-state analyses, and fault cases. Assess convergence, model assumptions, and the physical validity of results.
- Develop reference solutions and verification code that checks outputs such as voltage, current, efficiency, losses, timing, stability, protection behavior, and design constraints, with explicit units and tolerances.
- Package model files, dependencies, scripts, and results so another engineer can reproduce the work. Validate checks against both correct and deliberately incorrect cases.
- Review AI-generated engineering artifacts and diagnose failures in the design, simulation setup, or verifier. Use coding agents where helpful while independently checking their output.

**Ideal Qualifications**

- 5+ years of professional electrical engineering experience, with direct ownership of circuit designs, power systems, controls, or product validation.
- Recent hands-on experience with relevant tools such as KiCad, Altium, Cadence, SPICE/ngspice, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent engineering software. Expertise in every listed tool is not required.
- Ability to write, inspect, and debug Python or comparable scripts for simulation automation, data analysis, and numerical checks.
- Sound judgment about component behavior, numerical accuracy, safety margins, and applicable standards; ability to distinguish simulation predictions from measured laboratory evidence.
- Clear technical writing and a disciplined approach to documenting assumptions, reproducibility, and failure modes.
- A professional engineering credential and experience with test automation, engineering training, or evaluation design are a plus.

**Compensation**

- Writers: $70–$80/hour.
- Reviewers: $90/hour.

**Role Overview**

Mercor is seeking experienced mechanical engineers to build and validate technical tasks for AI systems working on product design, engineering analysis, and simulation. The work focuses on native CAD and analysis artifacts, physically sound models, reproducible solver runs, and measurable design outcomes.

Contributors develop tasks within their specialties, including CAD and assemblies, structural or thermal analysis, fluid mechanics, and manufacturing engineering. CAD evaluation, finite-element analysis, and computational fluid dynamics are distinct workflows; the modeling and verification method should fit the task.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Create realistic engineering problems with native geometry, assemblies, materials, loads, boundary conditions, and design requirements.
- Build and debug analysis models in relevant areas such as stress and deformation, thermal behavior, vibration, or fluid flow. For simulation tasks, assess mesh quality, convergence, sensitivity, and physical consistency.
- Produce reference solutions and reproducible CAD, FEA, or CFD workflows using tools appropriate to the problem, such as SolidWorks, FreeCAD, CATIA, ANSYS, CalculiX, OpenFOAM, or equivalents.
- Define checks for dimensions, assembly relationships, mass properties, manufacturability, stress, displacement, temperature, pressure drop, or other relevant outputs. Apply numerical checks, artifact inspection, and engineering judgment where each is appropriate.
- Package native files, solver settings, scripts, and results; document assumptions and limitations so another engineer can reproduce the work.
- Validate reference outcomes and incorrect cases, review AI-generated artifacts, and diagnose whether failures arise from the design, model setup, numerical method, or verification logic.
- Apply relevant standards and methods, including ASME or ISO, GD&T, DFM/DFA, and reliability analysis.

**Ideal Qualifications**

- 5+ years of professional mechanical engineering experience, with direct ownership of product designs, engineering analysis, manufacturing processes, or validation.
- Recent hands-on depth in one or more relevant CAD, FEA, CFD, or thermal-analysis workflows. Expertise across all specialties or all named packages is not required.
- Ability to automate analysis or inspect results using Python, MATLAB, shell scripts, or comparable tools, with coding-agent assistance where useful.
- Strong judgment about model fidelity, material behavior, boundary conditions, numerical convergence, and physical plausibility.
- Clear technical communication and a disciplined approach to reproducible engineering work.
- A professional engineering credential and prior test automation, design documentation, or engineering-training experience are a plus.

**Compensation**

- Writers: $70–$80/hour.
- Reviewers: $90/hour.

Role Overview 
 In this project, you will leverage your expertise in hematology and oncology to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT). Your deep understanding of cancer diagnostics, chemotherapy protocols, and hematologic disorders will help ensure AI systems deliver accurate, empathetic, and safe medical reasoning.
 What You’ll Do 
 • Design and solve advanced clinical scenarios reflecting hematology/oncology practice, from complex chemotherapy regimen selection to managing coagulopathies, anemias, and hematologic malignancies.
 • Evaluate AI-generated responses for diagnostic accuracy, clinical judgment, and evidence-based reasoning in hematology and oncology.
 • Identify gaps in AI understanding across hematology/oncology subspecialties including solid tumors, bone marrow transplant, and supportive/palliative care.
 • Collaborate with AI researchers and medical peers to improve model quality and reliability.
 • Provide structured, expert feedback that informs next-generation AI development for clinical and educational applications.
 Candidate Requirements 
 • MD or equivalent; active practice within the last 3+ years.
 • Board certification or equivalent qualification in Hematology and/or Oncology.
 • Strong grasp of hematology and oncology — solid tumors, hematologic malignancies, coagulation disorders, and cancer therapeutics.
 • Skilled in articulating complex medical reasoning in clear, patient-friendly language.
 • Excellent written and spoken English; familiarity with digital medical tools is a plus.
 • Education from a top-tier institution (e.g., Harvard, Stanford, UCSF, Oxford, etc.).
 Offer Details 
 • Commitment: 20–40 hours/week (minimum 4 hours/day, with overlap in PST)
 • Engagement: Contractor/freelancer (no medical or paid leave)
 • Duration: 1 month, with possible extension
 • Remote: Fully remote, collaborative environment

vagas.descricao:
About Us 
Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in software engineering, logical reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

 Project Overview 
We are seeking high-caliber researchers and technical experts. The core objective of this role is to enhance the reasoning and problem-solving capabilities of a target frontier model by designing, validating, and analyzing challenging benchmark tasks.

What the role entails:
 • Task Design and Development: Design challenging, real-world problems that serve as the foundation for a model. Problems should be constructed to target specific core capability loss failures identified in a leading model.
 • Content Generation: Integrate the problems into an Agentic development environment, preparing all necessary components using Python, which include: • Detailed Instructions and an overview of the required task.
 • A Golden solution that follows the instructions.
 • The necessary Environment, including datasets, Python libraries, and metadata.
 • A Test notebook containing unit tests that solutions must pass.
 
 • Evaluation and Analysis: Evaluate the cross model’s performance on the tasks.
 • Headroom Identification: Identify tasks where target model fails to pass all tests, specifically classifying the failure as a logical reasoning failure.
 • Loss Extraction: Analyze the agent’s steps (Agent Trajectory) to observe and extract core capability loss patterns from the model.
 Required Skills 
 • Highly-skilled GitHub contributors.
 • Applicants must have strong expertise in either data science, ML, coding, or a deep quantitative background in frontier STEM.
 • Able to engage reliably for 30+ hrs per week (on weekdays).
 Evaluation Process 
 • The application process takes ~15 minutes.
 • Completion of an AI video interview is required.
